bio.phrase1: I've worked in tech for over ten years and have been building software professionally since 2017. Today I work as a <important>full-stack engineer</important>, with a strong frontend foundation and hands-on experience across backend development, mobile applications, databases, and application architecture.
bio.phrase2: I've been interested in computers since I was a kid, so technology felt like a natural path. I graduated in Systems Analysis and Development in 2017, but my career had already started a year earlier in technical support for a supermarket chain.
bio.phrase3: After graduation, I moved to Curitiba to work with native Android development. The role soon expanded into backend and frontend work as well, which made it my first real full-stack experience. I later returned to the supermarket chain as a developer, where I built internal systems and took responsibility for BI reporting with QlikView.
bio.phrase4: A few years into my career, I wanted to experience startup life and joined aiqfome as a frontend developer. Even though the frontend was my main focus, I continued contributing to the backend when needed, eventually became a tech lead, and helped with the technical integration into Magazine Luiza's ecosystem after the acquisition. Looking for a different kind of challenge, I moved to CI&T and worked on an international product used across more than 18 countries. I later joined Avenue Code, where I worked on Stellantis websites for brands such as Fiat and Ram.
bio.phrase5: My work has ranged from internal systems to products operating at international scale. At Grupo Superpão, I built an HR platform that managed more than 10,000 candidate profiles and helped reduce issue resolution time from three days to under one hour. At CI&T, I contributed to a B2B platform serving more than 2.7 million monthly active users across 18 countries. At Avenue Code, I worked on automotive websites with millions of monthly visitors. Those experiences taught me to look beyond implementation and understand how the software affects the business and the people who use it.
bio.phrase6: I've always tried to keep learning and understand where the industry is heading. Today I also work on products and solutions that use AI. I continue going deeper into LLM applications, RAG architectures, and agents, while building projects that turn those ideas into practice and expand what I can deliver.
bio.phrase7: I tend to help beyond the feature I'm assigned, especially when a tool or a shared space can make the team's work easier. At aiqfome, I started a frontend guild where people could exchange knowledge and unblock each other. At CI&T, I built internal tools to speed up difficult debugging workflows. I also enjoy code reviews, supporting other developers, and working closely with product and design so that technical decisions make sense for the product as a whole.
